{{Top|leg}}
The '''Quantill City harbor''' was located on the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].

It was targeted by [[Pyash Yopayomba]] to start a planetary civil war during the [[Portage Moon Festival]]. Her plans were foiled when [[Sissalik]] took control of the explosive-laden ''[[Nanda's Luck]]'' and [[Battle of Portage Moon|rammed]] it into her [[Majestic (pirate ship)|ship]] instead of the harbor.
